_doc: Hand-maintained capability table (lead-reviewed). One entry per capability id used by api-rules.json, contributes.json, activation.json, menus.json, when.json, SURFACES.md and data/ourcode-*.json. gap = today vs what route 2b needs end-to-end (ADR 0031): extension-facing capabilities that need the host/adapter are never Have; API-fed ui.* surfaces: UI Have -> Missing-backend, UI Partial/Missing -> Missing-both; declarative-only surfaces keep the UI status. provides = who does the work under 2b. milestone = when extensions using the capability stop failing gates g2/g3 (design.md §6 shape milestone, ui.md §9 WP milestone; the later one when both are needed). doc links are relative to docs/vsx-compat/. today/evidence come from data/ourcode-*.json (and cited doc lines); effort scale per COMMON: S <=2 agent-days, M <=1 week, L <=3 weeks, XL >3 weeks.
